title: ACA Conformance Profiles
description: Minimum evidence expectations per risk tier, so 'enough proof' is objective. The required boundary-source strength graduates with the tier (the ACA boundary ladder: Declared -> Evidenced -> Verified -> Enforced).

T1.note: Bounded, low-risk. Controls may be declared.

T2.note: Enterprise data. Controls should be evidenced.

T3.note: Influences decisions. Controls should be evidenced.

T4.note: Action-capable. Key controls should be verified by test.

T5.note: High-impact / autonomous / regulated. Boundaries should be enforced at runtime.
